metadata.source_file: 大禹渡灌区总干渠断面情况汇总表.csv
metadata.reference: 1D WEB.md 第2.1节及 CrossSection.geojson 的FeatureCollection结构
metadata.units_assumption: 尺寸、水深、长度按m；流量按m3/s；流速按m/s；倾角字段按原表标题为度，不推断其他含义
metadata.profile_coordinates: z_list 为底部z=0的相对高度；cumulative_distances 为从最左侧x=0起的横向局部坐标
metadata.geometry_status: local cross-section only; original model bed elevations preserved
metadata.dll_compatibility: extended native set_CrossSection reads hydraulic_lookup and exact node associations
metadata.missing_value_policy: 空白数值->null；真实0保留；原始13列保存在source_values
metadata.association: exact mesh/stake.json 总干渠 station-to-node mapping; no XY-distance approximation
metadata.overflow_policy: explicit vertical wall extension above table height; report exceedances
metadata.unresolved_policy: retain existing model geometry and report incomplete/closed sections
